dossier.title: Release: v2.3.0 - Search and filters
dossier.subtitle: Full-text search across all document fields, saved filters, and a 30% speedup on large datasets.

blocks.text: v2.3.0 adds full-text search, saved filter sets, and improved query performance. The search indexes the title, tags, and all prose text in every document.

blocks.text: Search uses IndexedDB. Older Safari versions (before 16.4) may not have full support for certain query types. We have a fallback to in-memory search for those users.
If a user has more than 10,000 documents, indexing will run in the background and search results may be incomplete during the first 5 minutes after opening the app.
